```plato
    // The body with its pose advanced by its current velocity — the SECOND half of
    // a semi-implicit step, which must run after the velocity is final.
    IntegratePose(self: SolverBody3D, seconds: Number): SolverBody3D
        => SolverBody3D(
            self.Center + self.Velocity.Linear * seconds,
            IntegrateOrientation(self.Orientation, self.Velocity.Angular, seconds),
            self.Velocity,
            self.InverseMass,
            self.InverseInertia,
            self.LinearDamping,
            self.AngularDamping,
            self.GravityScale);
```
